detail: No exact commands or environment variables for the six v2 paper runs/ablations are released.
No frozen config dump proves which non-default planner, scheduler, trace, selector, critique, or merge settings were used.
Prompts, responses, hypotheses, DAGs, generated code, validation scores, errors, and selections are absent.

Complete branch/tag history and all 1,854 accessible public forks contain developmental diagnostics, debug pickles, example outputs, preserved world-model artifacts, and run commands, but no artifact is attributable to the published 75-competition three-seed runs.
Both advertised aka.ms result links currently resolve to generic Bing pages.
Dockerfile clones openai/mle-bench without a commit and performs live Git LFS pulls.
The 75 competition datasets, exact versions, hashes, and access records are not archived.
Exact task order, exclusions, retry policy, and Lite/Medium/High mapping artifact are absent.
GPT-5, o3, GPT-4.1, o1-preview, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek deployments/revisions are not pinned.
Temperature, top-p, max tokens, seed support, retry/backoff, timeout, and structured-output behavior are not fully pinned per role.
The v2 paper reports three seeds but does not list them or bind them to runs.
V100, 12-vCPU, and 220-GB allocations are stated but no scheduler/container digest proves the runtime image.
No logs establish wall-clock accounting, API wait treatment, restarts, or timeout boundaries.
Source default is 80/20; no run override or generated split indices establish the paper's 90/10 split.
The appendix selector implementation logs validation and test scores; exact held-out construction and separation from Kaggle test grading need released evidence.
Official baseline values and ML-Master re-evaluations lack pinned commits, commands, configs, seeds, and raw outputs.
Token/request logs, Azure prices, currency/date, caching, retries, and failed-call accounting are absent.
The 85-competition knowledge corpus, documents, embeddings, retrieval model, and hashes are absent.
Only labels are published; exact config diffs for all research/development ablations are not released.
Four result figures have no plotting data or generation scripts.
The report was rewritten around a new 12-hour GPT-5 experiment without a migration/result lineage document.
The official README does not expose the final-paper GPT-5 experiment and reports different hybrid values.
Only rounded raw percentages are published; at least one SEM cannot be reconstructed at displayed precision.
InternAgent and Neo methods/results cannot be independently audited from this repository.
The retained corpus maps a quant application lineage to a general MLE-Bench primary paper; quant proxy results cannot validate this paper.
